known_change_since_1756: Fenland and Wash drainage (Lincolnshire / Cambridgeshire), Somerset Levels, local estuary reclamation on the Mersey, Tees and Humber
scale_of_change: tens of km2 each, concentrated in estuaries and already-low-lying interior fen
effect_at_6km: marginal; affects the seaward edge of a small number of coastal hexes, not the interior
treatment: recorded and carried as a known limitation; the mainland interior is not withheld on account of it
note: The canonical geography adopts the PRESENT-DAY coastline as physical substrate. That is not a claim to have reconstructed the 1756 shoreline, and this audit exists so the claim is never read that way.
